name: Search API Recombee
description: A Search API backend that indexes content in Recombee for recommendation-powered search.
project_description:
This module provides a Recombee backend for the Search API module.

 The backend uses the Recombee SaaS personalization engine for indexing content. It has great performance, is suitable even for use on large commercial websites. 

 The Search API backend does not support facets or searching. It is useful just for indexing content into Recombee, improving the recommendations it is able to make. The backend is capable of indexing more than one site, allowing for federated recommendations across multiple Drupal sites.

 Other Modules 
 Recombee 
 Recombee is a copanion module which can be used to track users and display recommendations coming out of the Recombee API.

 We strongly advise that this module be configured so that the index which is propulated by this module can be properly used to drive the results when they are returned.
